Findings.Finding: An ordinary result suppresses recovery of another symbol in the same multi-result region.

Findings.Disposition: Reproduced for EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and UPC-E. Threshold-local evidence is independent of candidate deduplication. Supported short add-on spacing is retained only for whole-row validation; local base-only quiet-zone requirements remain.

TargetedFinding.Validation: 109 focused contracts pass; two typed/default same-base-with-supplement cases cover array/span/scanner.

ChangedDecoders: Retail image decoding uses constrained UPC-A/EAN parity and wider row coverage after ordinary decoding fails or multiple-result callers seek additional payloads; digit residuals, full guards, parity and checksum validation remain required.

Fourteen anchors per axis and at most two adjacent refinements per guarded anchor recover off-centre photographs. Two complementary local cutoffs supplement the existing thresholds only during fallback.

Retail image hits require the same type and complete payload on a nearby physical row or column. One- and two-pixel scanline inputs remain supported. This rejects a pre-existing noise-image UPC-E false positive.

The same behavior reaches byte-array/span single/all decoders and located scanner results. Retail add-ons, cancellation and existing deduplication contracts remain covered. No new public API or production dependency.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 219/267 correct positive images versus 208/267 previously; gained: upca-1/8.png, upca-1/4.png, upca-2/46.png, upca-2/07.png, upca-3/06.png, upca-4/14.png, upca-4/19.png, upca-4/7.png, upca-5/33.png, upce-2/41.png, upce-2/35.png; previously correct positive images lost: none. Paired negative completion is [29, 24, 30, 30]/31 currently and [29, 28, 30, 30]/31 previously. Retail fallback costs are measured separately and remain visible. No recognition allowance, hint, oracle or scoring change. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. Invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracles and undeclared QR encoding policies remain unchanged. Shared-host contention and budgets affect results. Stacked DataBar/Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported. These finite workloads do not establish overall superiority.
